title: Will this workshop cover its costs?
description: Change attendance, ticket price and costs. See the remaining budget and how many attendees are needed to break even.
assumptions: One paid ticket per attendee; everyone pays the same price in USD.
Per-person costs scale with attendance. Fixed costs do not change within the modeled range.
Taxes, refunds, payment fees and unpaid labor are excluded unless already included in the entered costs.

inputs.label: Paid attendees
inputs.help: Number of people buying a ticket.

inputs.label: Ticket price
inputs.help: Price paid by each attendee, in USD.

inputs.label: Cost per attendee
inputs.help: Materials, food and other costs that scale with attendance.

inputs.label: Fixed costs
inputs.help: Room hire and other costs paid regardless of attendance.

outputs.label: Budget remaining
outputs.help: Revenue minus total costs. A negative value is a shortfall.

outputs.label: Attendees to break even
outputs.help: Fixed costs ÷ contribution per attendee, rounded up to the next whole attendee.

constraints.message: Ticket price must exceed cost per attendee to calculate a break-even attendance. Raise the price or lower the per-person cost.
This attendance does not cover the stated costs. The negative remaining budget is the shortfall.
